recognize_zh: 上肢可見大小不一、邊界清楚的紅色斑片與斑塊（蕈狀肉芽腫 IB 期）；背部則散布孤立的紅色小丘疹與結節，部分表面結痂或出血，會自行消退，符合合併淋巴瘤樣丘疹病（lymphomatoid papulosis）。
features: Panel A (arm): multiple erythematous to violaceous patches and slightly infiltrated plaques of variable size, some annular or coalescent
Plaques with scaly surfaces distributed along the extensor forearm and upper arm
Panel B (back): scattered discrete erythematous papules and small nodules
Several trunk papules with central crust, hemorrhagic or necrotic tops and small hyperpigmented residual macules, indicating different stages of evolution
Intervening trunk skin appears uninvolved by patches
describe_en: Clinical photographs show, on the arm (panel A), multiple erythematous to violaceous scaly patches and plaques of varying size, consistent with mycosis fungoides. On the back (panel B), there are scattered discrete erythematous papules and small nodules in different stages of evolution, some with central crusts or hemorrhagic tops and others resolving as pigmented macules. No large ulcerated tumors are seen. Findings are consistent with coexisting mycosis fungoides (stage IB) and lymphomatoid papulosis; biopsy of a trunk papule would be expected to show CD30+ large atypical cells, and clonal relationship between the two can be assessed by TCR sequencing.

ddx.vs: Transformed MF produces persistent, enlarging tumors arising within plaques with >25% large cells, whereas LyP papules spontaneously regress within weeks.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous anaplastic large cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: C-ALCL presents as solitary or grouped persistent nodules >2 cm that rarely regress completely, unlike recurrent self-healing crops of small papules.
PLEVA also shows crusted papules in crops but lacks CD30+ large atypical cells and is not associated with MF.
Bite reactions are grouped pruritic papules with eosinophil-rich wedge-shaped infiltrates that may contain CD30+ cells but lack a recurrent chronic course or associated MF.
